value.text: Found a couple of options for the kids in New York for the 12th to the 15th. American Museum of Natural History is open daily 10am-5:30pm, USD 28 adults / 16 kids. Long Island Childrens Museum has a 10:00-11:30 session every day in November (2026-11-01 through 2026-11-28), USD 17, so the 12th to the 15th all work (2026-11-12, 2026-11-13, 2026-11-14, 2026-11-15). Sources: American Museum of Natural History and Long Island Childrens Museum.
